notes: Primary research article (J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2009, 131, 7016). Five carbons (AC, AC-C2, AC-C4, AC-K3, AC-K5) with BET areas in Table 1; H2 uptake at 77 K, 0-1 bar volumetric (Fig. 4) and 1-20 bar gravimetric Rubotherm (Fig. 7, Table 2). SI describes He buoyancy correction, a G212 reference carbon (1409 m2/g; 1.77 wt% at ~1 bar, 3.88 wt% at ~20 bar) and four repeated AC-K5 runs (Fig. S3). The starting AC is cited to ref. 21, but the paper does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before; not retracted per record and text.
